g.text: same matrix, same 0–45% scale, for the controls

text.style: font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: Colour and cell text are the same number: the percentage of the n = 193 non-substrate controls carrying the same motif with that class at that position (one peptide = 0.52%). Blank = 0%, no peptide in the group. Rows are alphabetical; the chip beside each label is its chemical class.

text.style: font-size: 5.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: This is composition, NOT enrichment — a residue frequent here may be just as frequent among the substrates. This is the background panel: the same matrix, on the same colour scale, for the controls. Compare with Figure 18 / 19 for the other group, and with Figures 16–17 for significance.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Chemical class frequency by position — the 193 non-substrate controls (background panel)
